name: container-management
title: Native container management: read-only API and simulation
description: Phase 1: native read-only container APIs, dual-UI flat editor, isolated simulation and regression checks.
creator: tom
notes: Phase 1 continues in Draft PR #30. Direct container-IP access replaces port mappings. Optional IPv6/MAC collapse, inline runtime Files browsing and row trash icons are implemented. The full dual-UI program is deployed as an isolated rosboard-container-test service on test port 8080; authentication, real snapshot/Files, validation, write denial and embedded assets passed runtime checks. Upload/mkdir and container mutations remain simulation-only. Awaiting full-panel visual acceptance/root review; real writes and production acceptance remain deferred.
